d:
Xoom Patrol is BACK for Season 2!
In the season premiere, Vineeth Kumar and Macwin (aka Mac Macha) head over to the scenic hills of Coorg. But if you think this is just a peaceful getaway to watch the stars, you clearly don’t know how Karan Singh operates.
To unlock the coordinates to the ultimate stargazing spot, the duo has to survive a series of chaotic curveballs, including a massive cooking challenge under a terrifyingly stern local chef. Add to that the punchy performance of the new Hero Xoom 125, and this turns into one absolutely manic episode in the hills.
Ready, set, Xoom Patrol!
